findings.ref: delivered human-copy lite-spec/SKILL.md '## Risk-Upgrade Gate' Capability-derived signal paragraph; security-spec.md B2; requirements.md Security Boundaries
findings.note: Unhandled error path on the Security-Sensitive/high Block gate. The delivered gate text authorizes omitting the second argument in exactly one case - no Project Context at all - and specifies no behaviour when a Project Context DOES exist but the Registry read or an evaluate-predicate invocation is unavailable, errors, or returns unparseable output. The unstated default lands the caller on the legacy byte-identical path, which is what this feature's own security text forbids: B2 names the asset as 'a caller that attempts to supply a Capability-derived signal and fails must never be silently treated as one that never attempted to'. B2's exit-2 mitigation lives inside check-risk-upgrade and structurally cannot see a caller that never passes the argument, so the fail-closed property is claimed but not enforced at the producer side this task owns. design.md's own REQ-005 algorithm is equally silent, so the root gap may be inherited from the frozen design - but the delivered state does not enforce the stated property either way.
